messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable game inspired by the look and action of *Attack on Titan*.

## Requirements
- “Create attack on Titan look the same as the anime.”
- Build the game now without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.

## Decisions
- Created an original, anime-inspired wall-defense game called **LAST LIGHT**, using custom canvas art and no existing-series assets.
- Built as a standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with keyboard and touch controls.

## Work State

### Completed
- Added a playable game in `index.html` and `game.js`: hook traversal, nape strikes, three targets, gate integrity, gas, timer, win/loss screens, and responsive touch controls.
- Started a local server and tested desktop and mobile layouts in Playwright; fixed an initial `titans` initialization error and verified there were no remaining console errors.

### Active
- Review the mobile layout: the screenshot shows the character at the far right, and the touch controls overlap the bottom-left instructions.
- Finish any polish and provide the user a concise summary, including the assumption that the game is an original work inspired by the anime’s visual style.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Adjust mobile gameplay positioning and prevent the touch controls from obscuring instructions.
2. Recheck gameplay and responsive layout, then report the completed build.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface, styles, HUD, title and result screens, touch controls.
- `game.js`: Game logic, canvas visuals, movement, grappling, attacks, and input handling.
- `screenshots/mobile.png`: Captured mobile viewport showing the current layout issue.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Tested via `playwright-cli` at `http://localhost:3002`; desktop and mobile screenshots were saved under `screenshots/`.
